title: Portfolio transaction (one entry of portfolio/transactions.json)
description: Transactions are never edited or deleted. A mistake is corrected by voiding the entry (voided=true with a reason) and adding a new one.

date.description: ISO date or date-time (UTC when a time is given).

asset_id.description: Economic asset ID (CoinGecko ID for tokens, 'usd' for cash). One asset on several chains keeps one ID.

price_usd.description: Per-unit price. Null means unknown; cost basis stays unknown.

transfer_id.description: Links a transfer_out with its transfer_in between your own accounts (including bridges).

btc_price_usd.description: BTC/USD at the time, used for BTC-relative performance.
